Il futuro ti assomiglia

I tuoi compiti

• Contatto proattivo del cliente

• Consulenza professionale

• Assicurare una presenza di un negozio ben curato

• Ambasciatori del nostro marchio

• Condividi la responsabilità di aprire e chiudere il negozio

Cosa porti

• Passione per la moda e le persone

• Flessibile in termini di tempi operativi

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione

• Esperienza di vendita nel settore della moda è vantaggioso

Cosa offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro emozionante e dinamico

• 30% di sconto sui dipendenti in tutti i nostri negozi

• 20% di sconto sui dipendenti nel nostro negozio online

Non discriviamo in base all'età, alla disabilità, all'identità di genere, all'orientamento sessuale, all'origine etnica, al colore, alla religione o alla fede, allo stato genitore o coniugale o a qualsiasi altra proprietà protetta. Accogliamo con favore le domande di donne, uomini e persone non-binary di tutti i background etnici e socio-economici.
Incoraggiamo particolarmente le persone provenienti da gruppi sottorappresentati ad applicare.
Anche se non si soddisfa ogni esigenza, ma si veda nel ruolo e vuole contribuire, applicare e aiutarci a costruire una comunità inclusiva.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you

Your tasks

• Proactive customer contact

• Professional advice

• Ensure a well-kept store presence

• Ambassadors of our brand

• Share responsibility for opening and closing the store

What you bring

• Passion for fashion and people

• Flexible in terms of operating times

• Very good communication skills

• Sales experience in the fashion industry is beneficial

What we offer

• Exciting and dynamic working environment

• 30% employee discount in all our stores

• 20% employee discount in our online shop

• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers

• Bonus and compensation of overtime

• 5 weeks holiday

• Feedback culture and development opportunities

We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, colour, religion or belief, parenthood or marital status or any other protected property. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary persons of all ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds.
We particularly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.
Even if you do not meet every requirement, but see yourself in the role and want to contribute, apply and help us build an inclusive community.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you

Your responsibilities

What you bring

What we offer

C&A fosters equal opportunity for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are led by a gender-balanced board that is committed to building a diverse and inclusive organization where everyone can become their best self.
We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion or belief, parental and family status, or any other protected characteristic. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary candidates of all ethnicities and socio-economic backgrounds. We encourage people belonging to underrepresented groups to apply.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il futuro ti assomiglia

Le tue responsabilità

Cosa porti

Cosa offriamo

C&A promuove pari opportunità per persone di tutti gli sfondi e identità. Siamo guidati da una tavola equilibrata di genere che si impegna a costruire un'organizzazione diversificata e inclusiva in cui tutti possono diventare il loro migliore sé.
Non discriviamo in base all'età, alla disabilità, all'identità di genere, all'orientamento sessuale, all'etnia, alla razza, alla religione o alla fede, allo stato dei genitori e della famiglia, o a qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta. Accogliamo con favore le domande di donne, uomini e candidati non-binari di tutte le etnie e background socio-economici. Incoraggiamo le persone appartenenti a gruppi sottorappresentati ad applicare.
Anche se non si controlla ogni casella, ma si veda contribuire, si prega di applicare e aiutarci a costruire una comunità inclusiva.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Zukunft sieht aus wie du

Ihre Verantwortung

Was du mitbringst

Was wir anbieten

C&A fördert Chancengleichheit für Menschen aller Hintergründe und Identitäten. Wir werden von einem ausgewogenen Vorstand geleitet, der sich dem Aufbau einer vielfältigen und integrativen Organisation verschrieben hat, in der jeder sein bestes Selbst werden kann.
Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von alter, behinderung, geschlechtsidentität, sexueller orientierung, ethnischer zugehörigkeit, rasse, religion oder weltanschauung, eltern- und familienstatus oder anderen geschützten merkmalen. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Frauen, Männern und nicht-binären Kandidaten aller Ethnien und sozioökonomischen Hintergründe. Wir ermutigen Menschen, die zu unterrepräsentierten Gruppen gehören, sich zu bewerben.
Auch wenn Sie nicht jedes Kästchen ankreuzen, aber sehen, dass Sie einen Beitrag leisten, bewerben Sie sich bitte und helfen Sie uns, eine integrative Community aufzubauen.

Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, mais voyez vous-même contribuer, s'il vous plaît postuler et nous aider à construire une communauté inclusive.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you

Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family.
We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing.
In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people.

Your tasks

• Visual appearance of the store

• Design of shop windows according to central specifications

• Implementation of an optimal product presentation in close cooperation with the Store Leader and the sales team

• Ambassadors of our brand

What you bring

• Passion for fashion and people

• Flexible in terms of operating times

• Very good communication skills

• Several years of professional experience as a Visual Merchandiser

What we offer

• Exciting and dynamic working environment

• 30% employee discount in all our stores

• 20% employee discount in our online shop

• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers

• Bonus and compensation of overtime

• 5 weeks holiday

• Feedback culture and development opportunities

We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, colour, religion or belief, parenthood or marital status or any other protected property. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary persons of all ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds.
We particularly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.
Even if you do not meet every requirement, but see yourself in the role and want to contribute, apply and help us build an inclusive community.

Depuis sa fondation par les frères Clemens et en août 1841, C&A a été un pionnier de la mode. De l'introduction de vêtements faits sur mesure, lorsque la personnalisation était encore la norme, à la popularisation des minijupes dans les années 60, à l'introduction du com-bi-kini dans les années 70, coton biologique au début de l'an 2000, au premier vêtement certifié or berceau à berceau en 2017 - nous sommes toujours allés avec le temps et avons rendu des vêtements élégants et de haute qualité possible pour tout le monde. Et bien que C&A et le monde qui nous entoure aient changé au cours des décennies, une chose est restée la même : notre engagement à offrir une mode durable et de qualité à toute la famille.
Nous voulons pour l'avenir une industrie de la mode plus innovante et durable; Celui qui se dirige vers un avenir circulaire et favorise un cycle d'utilisation, de réutilisation et de renaissance des vêtements.
En Suisse, C&A compte plus de 90 magasins et emploie plus de 1 300 personnes.

Vos tâches

• Aspect visuel du magasin

The future looks like you

Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family.
We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing.
In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people.

Your tasks

• Visual appearance of the store

• Design of shop windows according to central specifications

• Implementation of an optimal product presentation in close cooperation with the Store Leader and the sales team

• Several years of professional experience as a Visual Merchandiser

From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family.
We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing.
In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people.

Your tasks

• Visual appearance of the store

• Design of shop windows according to central specifications

• Implementation of an optimal product presentation in close cooperation with the Store Leader and the sales team

• Ambassadors of our brand

What you bring

• Passion for fashion and people

• Flexible in terms of operating times

• Very good communication skills

• Several years of professional experience as a Visual Merchandiser

What we offer

• Exciting and dynamic working environment

• 30% employee discount in all our stores

• 20% employee discount in our online shop

• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers

• Bonus and compensation of overtime

• 5 weeks holiday

• Feedback culture and development opportunities

The future looks like you Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family. We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing. descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family. We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing. In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people. Your tasks
• Proactive customer contact
• Professional advice
• Ensure a well-kept store presence
• Deputy of Store Leader
• Ambassadors of our brand What you bring
• Passion for fashion and people
• Flexible in terms of operating times
• Very good communication skills
• Self-responsible and team capable personality
• First management experience as a deputy desirable
• Sales experience in the fashion industry is beneficial What we offer
• Exciting and dynamic working environment
• 30% employee discount in all our stores
• 20% employee discount in our online shop
• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers
• Bonus and compensation of overtime
• 5 weeks holiday
• Feedback culture and development opportunities We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, colour, religion or belief, parenthood or marital status or any other protected property. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary persons of all ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds. We particularly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Even if you do not meet every requirement, but see yourself in the role and want to contribute, apply and help us build an inclusive community.

The future looks like you

Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 – we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family.
We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing.
In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people.

De l'introduction de vêtements faits sur mesure, lorsque la personnalisation était encore la norme, à la popularisation des minijupes dans les années 60, à l'introduction du com-bi-kini dans les années 70, coton biologique au début de l'an 2000, au premier vêtement certifié or berceau à berceau en 2017 - nous sommes toujours allés avec le temps et avons rendu des vêtements élégants et de haute qualité possible pour tout le monde. Et bien que C&A et le monde qui nous entoure aient changé au cours des décennies, une chose est restée la même : notre engagement à offrir une mode durable et de qualité à toute la famille. Nous voulons pour l'avenir une industrie de la mode plus innovante et durable; Celui qui se dirige vers un avenir circulaire et favorise un cycle d'utilisation, de réutilisation et de renaissance des vêtements. En Suisse, C&A compte plus de 90 magasins et emploie plus de 1 300 personnes. Vos tâches
• Aspect visuel du magasin
• Conception de fenêtres de magasin selon les spécifications centrales
• Mise en œuvre d'une présentation optimale des produits en étroite collaboration avec le Store Leader et l'équipe de vente
• Ambassadeurs de notre marque Ce que vous apportez
• Passion pour la mode et les gens
• Flexible en termes de temps d'exploitation
• Très bonnes compétences en communication
• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que marchand visuel Ce que nous offrons
• Environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique
• 30% de réduction des employés dans tous nos magasins
• 20% de réduction pour les employés dans notre boutique en ligne
• Portail d'avantages avec des offres de fournisseurs haut de gamme
• Prime et rémunération des heures supplémentaires
• 5 semaines de vacances
• Rétroaction sur la culture et les possibilités de développement Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur l'âge, le handicap, l'identité de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine ethnique, la couleur, la religion ou les convictions, la paternité ou l'état matrimonial ou tout autre bien protégé. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures des femmes, des hommes et des non-binaires de toutes origines ethniques et socioéconomiques. Nous encourageons particulièrement les personnes appartenant à des groupes sous-représentés à présenter leur candidature. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences, mais voyez-vous dans le rôle et voulez contribuer, appliquer et nous aider à bâtir une communauté inclusive.

Dall'introduzione di abbigliamento made-to-measure, quando la personalizzazione era ancora la norma, alla divulgazione di miniskirts negli anni '60, l'introduzione del com-bi-kini negli anni '70, cotone organico all'inizio del 2000, al primo cradle-to-cradle gold-certified indumento nel 2017 - siamo sempre andati con i tempi e abbiamo reso abbigliamento elegante e di alta qualità possibile per tutti. E mentre C&A e il mondo intorno a noi sono cambiati nel corso dei decenni, una cosa è rimasta la stessa: il nostro impegno a fornire moda sostenibile e di qualità per tutta la famiglia. Vogliamo per il futuro un'industria della moda più innovativa e sostenibile; Uno che si muove verso un futuro circolare e promuove un ciclo di utilizzo, riutilizzo e rinascita di abbigliamento. In Svizzera, C&A ha più di 90 negozi e impiega oltre 1.300 persone. descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family. We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing. In Switzerland, C&A has more than 90 stores and employs more than 1,300 people. Short description As a store visual merchandiser in the twin store concept, you take over the visual design in two stores with approximately 40% use each and ensure a uniform brand image at both locations. Your tasks
• Visual appearance of the store
• Design of shop windows according to central specifications
• Implementation of an optimal product presentation in close cooperation with the Store Leader and the sales team
• Ambassadors of our brand What you bring
• Flexible operational readiness of about 40% each in the stores Winterthur and Frauenfeld
• Passion for fashion and people
• Flexible in terms of operating times
• Very good communication skills
• Self-permanent working methods and a high level of initiative
• Several years of professional experience as a Visual Merchandiser What we offer
• Exciting and dynamic working environment
• 30% employee discount in all our stores
• 20% employee discount in our online shop
• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers
• Bonus and compensation of overtime
• 5 weeks holiday
• Feedback culture and development opportunities We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, colour, religion or belief, parenthood or marital status or any other protected property. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary persons of all ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds. We particularly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Even if you do not meet every requirement, but see yourself in the role and want to contribute, apply and help us build an inclusive community.

The future looks like you

Seit der Gründung durch die Brüder Clemens und August im Jahr 1841 ist C&A ein Vorreiter in Sachen Mode. Von der Einführung von Konfektionskleidung, als Massanfertigungen noch die Norm waren, über die Popularisierung von Miniröcken in den 60er Jahren, die Einführung des Com-Bi-Kini in den 70er Jahren, Bio-Baumwolle Anfang 2000, bis zum ersten Cradle-to-Cradle Gold-zertifizierten Kleidungsstück im Jahr 2017 - wir sind immer mit der Zeit gegangen und haben stilvolle und hochwertige Kleidung für alle möglich gemacht. Und während sich C&A und die Welt um uns herum im Laufe der Jahrzehnte verändert haben, ist eines gleichgeblieben: unser Engagement, nachhaltige und hochwertige Mode für die ganze Familie anzubieten.
Wir wünschen uns für die Zukunft eine Modeindustrie, die innovativer und nachhaltiger ist; eine, die sich auf eine zirkuläre Zukunft zubewegt und einen Kreislauf aus Nutzung, Wiederverwendung und Wiedergeburt von Kleidung fördert.
In der Schweiz ist C&A mit mehr als 90 Stores vertreten und beschäftigt über 1'300 Mitarbeitende.

Kurzbeschreibung

Als Store Visual Merchandiser im Twin-Store-Konzept übernimmst du die visuelle Gestaltung in zwei Stores mit je ca. 40 % Einsatz und sorgst für ein einheitliches Markenbild an beiden Standorten.

Deine Aufgaben

• Visuelles Erscheinungsbild des Stores

• Gestaltung der Schaufenster nach zentralen Vorgaben

• Umsetzung einer optimalen Warenpräsentation in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Store Leader und dem Verkaufsteam

• Botschafter unserer Marke

Was du mitbringst

• F lexible Einsatzbereitschaft von jeweils ca. 40% in den Stores Winterthur und Frauenfeld

• Leidenschaft für Mode und Menschen

• Flexibel in Bezug auf Einsatzzeiten

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• S elbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Eigeninitiative

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Visual Merchandiser

Was wir bieten

• Spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld

• 30% Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen unseren Stores

• 20% Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Onlineshop

• Vorteilsportal mit Angeboten von Top-Markenanbietern

• Bonus und Kompensierung von Überstunden

• 5 Wochen Ferien

• Feedbackkultur und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Alter, Behinderung, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Elternschaft oder Familienstand oder einer anderen geschützten Eigenschaft. descriptionByLocale.it:

The future looks like you Since its founding by the brothers Clemens and August in 1841, C&A has been a pioneer in fashion. From the introduction of made-to-measure clothing, when customization was still the norm, to the popularization of miniskirts in the 60s, the introduction of the com-bi-kini in the 70s, organic cotton in early 2000, to the first cradle-to-cradle gold-certified garment in 2017 - we have always gone with the times and made stylish and high-quality clothing possible for everyone. And while C&A and the world around us have changed over the decades, one thing has remained the same: our commitment to providing sustainable and quality fashion for the whole family. We want for the future a fashion industry that is more innovative and sustainable; One that moves toward a circular future and promotes a cycle of use, reuse and rebirth of clothing. • Ihre Verantwortung Was du mitbringst Was wir anbieten C&A fördert Chancengleichheit für Menschen aller Hintergründe und Identitäten. Wir werden von einem ausgewogenen Vorstand geleitet, der sich dem Aufbau einer vielfältigen und integrativen Organisation verschrieben hat, in der jeder sein bestes Selbst werden kann. Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von alter, behinderung, geschlechtsidentität, sexueller orientierung, ethnischer zugehörigkeit, rasse, religion oder weltanschauung, eltern- und familienstatus oder anderen geschützten merkmalen. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Frauen, Männern und nicht-binären Kandidaten aller Ethnien und sozioökonomischen Hintergründe. Wir ermutigen Menschen, die zu unterrepräsentierten Gruppen gehören, sich zu bewerben. Auch wenn Sie nicht jedes Kästchen ankreuzen, aber sehen, dass Sie einen Beitrag leisten, bewerben Sie sich bitte und helfen Sie uns, eine integrative Community aufzubauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le futur te ressemble
• Vos responsabilités Ce que vous apportez Ce que nous offrons C et A favorise l'égalité des chances pour les personnes de tous horizons et identités. Nous sommes dirigés par un conseil équilibré entre les sexes qui s'engage à bâtir une organisation diversifiée et inclusive où chacun peut devenir son meilleur individu. Nous ne faisons aucune discrimination fondée sur l'âge, le handicap, l'identité de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'ethnicité, la race, la religion ou les convictions, le statut parental et familial, ou toute autre caractéristique protégée. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de femmes, d'hommes et de candidats non binaires de toutes origines ethniques et socioéconomiques. Nous encourageons les personnes appartenant à des groupes sous-représentés à présenter leur candidature. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, mais voyez vous-même contribuer, s'il vous plaît postuler et nous aider à construire une communauté inclusive.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il futuro ti assomiglia

I tuoi compiti

• Contatto proattivo del cliente

• Consulenza professionale

• Assicurare una presenza di un negozio ben curato

• Ambasciatori del nostro marchio

Cosa porti

• Passione per la moda e le persone

• Flessibile in termini di tempi operativi

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione

• Esperienza di vendita nel settore della moda è vantaggioso

Cosa offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro emozionante e dinamico

• 30% di sconto sui dipendenti in tutti i nostri negozi

• 20% di sconto sui dipendenti nel nostro negozio online

• Portale Vantaggio con offerte dai migliori fornitori di marchi

• Bonus e compensazione degli straordinari

• 5 settimane di vacanza

• Feedback cultura e opportunità di sviluppo

Non discriviamo in base all'età, alla disabilità, all'identità di genere, all'orientamento sessuale, all'origine etnica, al colore, alla religione o alla fede, allo stato genitore o coniugale o a qualsiasi altra proprietà protetta. Accogliamo con favore le domande di donne, uomini e persone non-binary di tutti i background etnici e socio-economici.
Incoraggiamo particolarmente le persone provenienti da gruppi sottorappresentati ad applicare.
Anche se non si soddisfa ogni esigenza, ma si veda nel ruolo e vuole contribuire, applicare e aiutarci a costruire una comunità inclusiva.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The future looks like you

Your tasks

• Proactive customer contact

• Professional advice

• Ensure a well-kept store presence

• Ambassadors of our brand

What you bring

• Passion for fashion and people

• Flexible in terms of operating times

• Very good communication skills

• Sales experience in the fashion industry is beneficial

What we offer

• Exciting and dynamic working environment

• 30% employee discount in all our stores

• 20% employee discount in our online shop

• Advantage portal with offers from top brand providers

• Bonus and compensation of overtime

• 5 weeks holiday

• Feedback culture and development opportunities

We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, colour, religion or belief, parenthood or marital status or any other protected property. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary persons of all ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds.
We particularly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.
Even if you do not meet every requirement, but see yourself in the role and want to contribute, apply and help us build an inclusive community.
descriptionByLocale.de:
The future looks like you

Deine Aufgaben

• Proaktiver Kundenkontakt

• Professionelle Beratung

• Sicherstellen eines gepflegten Store-Auftritts

• Botschafter unserer Marke

Was du mitbringst

• Leidenschaft für Mode und Menschen

• Flexibel in Bezug auf Einsatzzeiten

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Verkaufserfahrung in der Modebranche von Vorteil

Was wir bieten

• Spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld

• 30% Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen unseren Stores

• 20% Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Onlineshop

• Vorteilsportal mit Angeboten von Top-Markenanbietern

• Bonus und Kompensierung von Überstunden

• 5 Wochen Ferien

• Feedbackkultur und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Alter, Behinderung, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Elternschaft oder Familienstand oder einer anderen geschützten Eigenschaft. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Frauen, Männern und nicht-binären Personen aller ethnischen und sozioökonomischen Hintergründe.
Wir ermutigen insbesondere Menschen aus unterrepräsentierten Gruppen, sich zu bewerben.
Auch wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, aber Dich in der Rolle siehst und einen Beitrag leisten möchtest, bewirb Dich gerne und hilf uns, eine inklusive Gemeinschaft aufzubauen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le futur te ressemble

Vos tâches

• Contact client proactif

• Conseils professionnels

• Assurer une bonne présence dans les magasins

• Ambassadeurs de notre marque

Ce que vous apportez

• Passion pour la mode et les gens

• Flexible en termes de temps d'exploitation

• Très bonnes compétences en communication

• L'expérience des ventes dans l'industrie de la mode est bénéfique

Ce que nous offrons

• Environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique

• 30% de réduction des employés dans tous nos magasins

• 20% de réduction pour les employés dans notre boutique en ligne

• Portail d'avantages avec des offres de fournisseurs haut de gamme

• Prime et rémunération des heures supplémentaires

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Rétroaction sur la culture et les possibilités de développement

Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur l'âge, le handicap, l'identité de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine ethnique, la couleur, la religion ou les convictions, la paternité ou l'état matrimonial ou tout autre bien protégé. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures des femmes, des hommes et des non-binaires de toutes origines ethniques et socioéconomiques.
Nous encourageons particulièrement les personnes appartenant à des groupes sous-représentés à présenter leur candidature.
Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences, mais voyez-vous dans le rôle et voulez contribuer, appliquer et nous aider à bâtir une communauté inclusive.
